column1: # derivation: d = p / q is +inf (id 1), -inf (ids 2, 5), NaN (ids 3, 7),
# NULL (ids 4, 8) and 0.25 (id 6) by §5.6. §5.7, float arithmetic is IEEE
# 754: inf + 1.0 = inf and -inf + 1.0 = -inf; an operation with a NaN
# operand is NaN; inf - inf is NaN (so d - d is NaN for both infinities);
# +0.0 (an exact zero result is +0 under round-to-nearest). d + r: r is 1.0
# except on id 3, where it is NULL, and an arithmetic operation with a NULL
# operand is NULL, NaN included (NULL dominates NaN, §5.7). Types: FLOAT64
# under each option of §8.9, the literals 1.0 and 0.0 FLOAT64 (§8.19);
